name: TRACE
author: Addicting Games
description: Trace is a free escape room game. The evidence is there; all you have to do is find it. In Trace, you will scour every aspect of every room in this abandoned chateau. It is your mission to unlock what happened by finding clues, collecting items, and unlocking the secrets of this island abode. Only you can really know what really happened. And you'll know if you point, click, collect, and pay attention.
